rationale: No existing Alerts spec asserts the redirect target after the add-alert header back button is clicked. Existing clickBackButton() call sites (scheduled-features, stream-switching, alerts-regression) only use the back button to close the wizard and never assert that the resulting /alerts URL preserves org_identifier (and folder). alerts-composite-ui navigates to /web/alerts/add but is composite-UI focused and never asserts back-redirect org preservation. The fix (goBackToAlertsList pushing org_identifier + folder) is a distinct, self-contained regression with its own feature slug and run-context spec_path, so a dedicated spec is cleaner than bolting an org-preservation assertion onto an unrelated existing spec. New spec must be registered in ci_matrix.json run_files under the Alerts testfolder.
